title: 第十五章 神秘高人第十六章 地下黑市感谢大大们的月票
content_zh:
出手的正是林夜，对方作恶多端，而且迟早回去杀他和其他同学，所以自己索性直接送走他，省的以后麻烦。
此刻，他则是正在盘算着接下来的计划。
在他的面前出现了一道‘光幕记事本’。
并不是脑力进化面板，也不是真实的光幕记事本，而是他幻想出来的光幕记事本。
普通人的脑力有限，稍微计算一点东西，就需要用纸张记下笔记。
林夜的脑力逐渐变强，已经堪比普通电脑的cpu处理器，所以他可以凭空制作‘光幕记事本’，就像在电脑上做出一个文件，做好了之后直接收入自己的大脑之中，就像收入一个文件夹储存。
“我接下来需要学习的，应该是化学知识。
化学可以帮我提取能量、浓缩能量，炼丹、制作高度浓缩能量药剂...都需要用到化学。
先把个人能源问题解决，再去开发外部战力增幅系统。”
从那些大厂的机密资料中，林夜了解到联邦各大顶级公司已经开始研发生化人、寻找超凡者、制作战斗机甲、机器人...
林夜以这一点做自己后续进阶或者创建势力的方案。
因为生命进化是一个缓慢过程，而且越往后所需要的时间越长，古武无法在短时间之内大幅度提升自身实力，必须要考虑依靠一部分外部辅助工具。
毕竟...使用工具才是智人的标致。
他可以创造战斗机甲、机器人，还能打造超级热武器！
此类需要学习数学、物理、信息编程等知识，信息编程自己已经掌握，所以只需要学习数学、物理就行了。
这两个知识放在化学后面。
另外...
“原本打算暂时搁置构建势力，是因为无法解决资金问题，现在通过虚拟账户全球炒股，已顺利解决资金问题。
而且经过今晚的观察和实战测试，我的实力在现实世界似乎还不错，只要稍微稳重谨慎一点，基本不会有什么大碍。
是应该稍微想办法着手打造势力了。”

打造势力对于自身提升是至关重要的一环。
魔都的材料有限，他不可能全球到处跑，去寻找和收购那些奇异宝药。
而且想要打造外部战力增幅系统，譬如战斗机甲...高尖端智能化热武器...这些也都需要高尖端的科学材料，制作过程也需要强大的人才负责操作。
他总不能自己搞个小作坊独自手搓，那得搓到猴年马月？
全球进化不是他一个人的进化，他不提前堆战力，万一碰到个强者，那就芭比扣了。
“我在学习知识的同时，可以同步进行肉身修为提升问题，且制作高浓缩能量药剂和丹药也需要基础材料。
后续如果想要研究科技机甲、高尖端热武器...也都需要从特殊渠道购买到材料。
先去黑市看看，确定稳定的货源，才能更好的进行接下来的计划安排。”
想到这里，林夜收起光幕记事本，将规划储存在脑海中，并伸手拦下了一辆出租车。
“师父，去浦江地下市场。”
...
而在林夜走后，另外两道身影也走到了这边。
“张队，对不起，都是我刚刚太大意了，如果我直接开枪击中他的话，他肯定就跑不了了。”
陈月满脸愧疚，张队却没有责备，只是宽慰道：
“都已经过去了，眼下最要紧的是抓紧找到这个家伙，不能让他再继续作恶下去。”
陈月点点头，眼神忽的注意到这边的异状，登时惊呼道：
“张队，你快看那儿。”
“那是...”
content_en:
It was Lin Ye who took action. The other party did many evil things and would go back to kill him and other classmates sooner or later, so I simply sent him away to save trouble in the future.
At this moment, he is planning his next plan.
A 'light curtain notepad' appeared in front of him.
It's not the brain evolution panel, nor the real light screen notepad, but the light screen notepad he imagined.
Ordinary people have limited brainpower, and if they do some calculations, they need to use paper to take notes.
Lin Ye's brainpower has gradually become stronger, and it has become comparable to the CPU processor of an ordinary computer, so he can create a 'light screen notepad' out of thin air, just like making a file on the computer, and then put it directly into his brain after it is completed, just like storing it in a folder.
“The next thing I need to learn is chemistry.
Chemistry can help me extract energy, concentrate energy, make elixirs, and make highly concentrated energy potions... all require chemistry.
Solve the personal energy problem first, and then develop an external combat power amplification system. "
From the confidential information of those major manufacturers, Lin Ye learned that the top companies in the Federation have begun to develop biochemicals, search for extraordinary beings, and produce combat mechas, robots...
Lin Ye used this as his plan to advance further or create a force.
Because the evolution of life is a slow process, and the longer it takes, the longer it takes. Gu Wu cannot significantly improve his strength in a short period of time, and must consider relying on some external auxiliary tools.
After all...the use of tools is the hallmark of Homo sapiens.
He can create fighting mechs, robots, and even super hot weapons!
This type requires learning mathematics, physics, information programming and other knowledge. Information programming has been mastered by yourself, so you only need to learn mathematics and physics.
These two pieces of knowledge are placed behind chemistry.
Also...
“Originally, we planned to temporarily shelve building power because we could not solve the funding problem. Now we have successfully solved the funding problem through global stock trading through virtual accounts.
And after tonight's observation and actual combat test, my strength seems to be pretty good in the real world. As long as I am a little more steady and cautious, there will basically be no serious problems.
It’s time to think of ways to start building your power. "
Building power is a crucial part of improving oneself.
The materials in the magic city are limited, and it is impossible for him to travel around the world to find and acquire those strange treasures.
And if you want to build an external combat power amplification system, such as combat mechas...high-end intelligent thermal weapons...these also require high-end scientific materials, and the production process also requires powerful talents to operate.
He couldn't set up his own small workshop and rub it by hand. Then he would have to rub it until the Year of the Monkey?
Global evolution is not his own evolution. He does not build up his combat power in advance. If he encounters a strong person, it will be Barbie's fault.
“While I am learning knowledge, I can simultaneously improve my physical body, and making highly concentrated energy potions and elixirs also requires basic materials.
If you want to research technological mechas or high-end thermal weapons in the future... you will also need to purchase materials from special channels.
Go to the black market first to determine a stable source of goods, so that you can make better arrangements for the next step. "
Thinking of this, Lin Ye put away the light screen notepad, stored the plan in his mind, and reached out to stop a taxi.
"Master, go to Pujiang Underground Market."
...
After Lin Ye left, two other figures also walked over.
"Captain Zhang, I'm sorry. I was too careless just now. If I shot him directly, he would definitely not be able to run away."
Chen Yue's face was full of guilt, but Captain Zhang did not blame him, but just said with relief:
"It's all over. The most important thing now is to find this guy quickly and not let him continue to do evil."
Chen Yue nodded, her eyes suddenly noticed thisSomething strange happened, and he immediately exclaimed:
"Captain Zhang, look over there."
"That's..."
